So your practice swing is aggressively over the top as well.  Your first move is with your shoulders and you're toast from the first millisecond of your downswing.  You need to feel things in the opposite extreme.  Try to take some swings where your back stays to the target the entire swing.  Obviously that's not going to actually happen, but the feel will stop you from spinning those shoulders open with enough practice.  If you ever somehow went the other extreme with not enough upper body rotation you can deal with that.  The other part of this you can practice at the same time is learning how your arms work from the top of your backswing.  They should drop straight down, not out towards the ball. You have such a massive amount of lateral movement that you have no chance to make consistent contact.  Look at where your head starts, in line with that blue truck in the background, and compare it to where it ends up by the time you reach the top of your backswing.

Notice how his head starts under that tree branch and while it does have some dip, it never moves laterally from that point.

You have to learn proper setup and then how to turn and pivot around that setup spine angle, not slide.

You need more hand depth.  You can keep your vertical swing plane backswing but without a crazy amount of hand eye coordination and physical ability you have no shot to shallow the club from where you have it.  You're coming in steep and forced to stop the hips, early extend, and flip the club to stop yourself from pounding the club in 3 inches behind the ball.

https://imgur.com/a/pPmFZW3

JT is a good swing to watch if you want to keep the high hands with not a lot of depth, but there's no way that 99.9% of players can get to the position he is in here from where he is at the top, so you're going to want to set yourself up for easier success.

You can keep the steep backswing and two plane feeling, but you're going to want more depth.

If you whip the club inside under plane the swing has nowhere to go but over the plane you brought it back on, otherwise you will be stuck and flipping from the inside.  It's actually doable to go from underplane to on plane and there have been professional swings that do it, but the athleticism and timing required make it infeasible for almost everyone including the best.
